title: 😤 Ayesha screenshots with two hands... the Back Tap she never set #iphone #accessibility
title_alts: 🙂 Ayesha maps Back Tap to Screenshot... one tap on the phone's back #iphone #backtap
😕 Ayesha's thick case eats the Back Tap... test it without the cover #iphone #backtap
description_hook: Ayesha took every screenshot with two hands until she turned the back of her iPhone into a button. Here is the exact Back Tap setting, and the case that quietly breaks it.
setting: a home desk and a kitchen counter

characters.name: Ayesha
characters.description: thirty-two, shoulder-length black hair tied back, grey cotton kurta, a small silver stud in her left ear

claims.basis: the Double Tap option is defined as two taps, so the count follows from the setting being chosen

scenes.narration: Every screenshot costs Ayesha two hands and an awkward stretch.
scenes.caption: हर स्क्रीनशॉट के लिए आयशा को दोनों हाथ और खिंचाव लगता है।
scenes.image_brief: A black iPhone lying face up on a pale wooden desk, thin glowing rings drawn around the side button and the volume up button on opposite edges, soft morning daylight from a window on the left.

scenes.narration: The built-in way needs the side button and volume up together.
scenes.caption: आम तरीक़े में साइड बटन और वॉल्यूम अप साथ दबाने पड़ते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A black iPhone standing upright on a grey table, the side button on its right edge and the volume up button on its left edge both lit with a warm glow, dim indoor light.

scenes.narration: Press them slightly apart? You get Siri instead.
scenes.caption: थोड़ा अलग-अलग दबाया? स्क्रीनशॉट की जगह सिरी खुल जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: A black iPhone screen showing the Siri listening circle glowing at the bottom instead of a screenshot, the phone propped against a plain beige wall, cool overhead light.

scenes.narration: Nothing to download here. The switch is already sitting inside Settings.
scenes.caption: कुछ डाउनलोड नहीं करना है। यह सेटिंग पहले से मौजूद है।
scenes.image_brief: The grey iOS Settings gear icon standing out brightly on a dark iPhone home screen while the surrounding app icons sit dimmed, the phone flat on a dark grey desk under a small lamp.

scenes.narration: Take the phone case off for now, so your taps land cleanly.
scenes.caption: अभी फ़ोन का कवर हटा दें, ताकि टैप ठीक से लगे।
scenes.image_brief: A bare black iPhone lying next to its removed silicone case on a white bedsheet, the metal edges of the phone visible, soft even daylight.

scenes.narration: Open Settings, then Accessibility, then Touch. Scroll right to the bottom.
scenes.caption: सेटिंग्स, फिर एक्सेसिबिलिटी, फिर टच खोलें। सबसे नीचे तक स्क्रॉल करें।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone screen showing the Accessibility settings list with a Touch row visible in the middle, the phone resting against a stack of books, warm desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: Tap Back Tap, then Double Tap. A long list of actions opens.
scenes.caption: बैक टैप, फिर डबल टैप चुनें। एक्शन की लंबी लिस्ट खुलेगी।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone screen showing a Back Tap settings page with two rows labelled Double Tap and Triple Tap, the phone held in one hand above a wooden table, bright indoor light.

scenes.narration: Choose Screenshot. Go back one screen and set Triple Tap as well.
scenes.caption: स्क्रीनशॉट चुनें। एक स्क्रीन पीछे जाकर ट्रिपल टैप भी सेट करें।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone screen showing a long scrollable list of Back Tap actions with a tick mark beside the Screenshot row, the phone flat on a grey desk mat, neutral daylight.

scenes.narration: Leave Settings completely. Tap the phone's back twice, fairly firmly.
scenes.caption: सेटिंग्स से पूरी तरह बाहर आएँ। फ़ोन की पीठ पर दो बार टैप करें।
scenes.image_brief: A fingertip touching the middle of the back panel of a black iPhone that is held upright in the other hand, a plain kitchen counter behind, soft window light.

scenes.narration: The screen flashes white and a thumbnail slides in. One hand only.
scenes.caption: स्क्रीन चमकेगी और थंबनेल दिखेगा। बस एक हाथ से।
scenes.image_brief: A black iPhone screen showing a map with a small square screenshot thumbnail sliding into the bottom left corner, the phone held in one hand, evening lamp light.

scenes.narration: Thick cases and pop sockets swallow the tap. Test yours first.
scenes.caption: मोटे कवर और पॉप सॉकेट टैप दबा देते हैं। पहले जाँच लें।
scenes.image_brief: A thick rugged phone case and a metal pop socket lying beside a bare black iPhone on a dark table, single overhead light.

scenes.narration: A bag can trigger it, so never assign anything you cannot undo.
scenes.caption: बैग में यह अपने आप चल सकता है, इसलिए ख़तरनाक एक्शन न चुनें।
scenes.image_brief: A black iPhone lying loose inside an open canvas tote bag with keys and a notebook, its screen dark, dim indoor light from above.

scenes.narration: Set Triple Tap to open the Camera, then try it one-handed.
scenes.caption: ट्रिपल टैप को कैमरा पर लगाएँ, फिर एक हाथ से आज़माएँ।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone camera app open and ready, the phone held in one hand at arm's length above a garden path, bright late afternoon sunlight.

title: 😑 Ishaan retypes his email daily... the Text Replacement he never set #iphone #keyboard
title_alts: 😮 Ishaan's Text Replacement types his whole email... from two letters #iphone #keyboard
😬 Ishaan saved a password in Text Replacement... why that is readable #iphone #passwords
description_hook: Ishaan typed his long email address into every form by hand. Text Replacement turns it into two letters, and there is one thing you must never store there.
setting: an office desk and a cafe table

characters.name: Ishaan
characters.description: twenty-eight, short curly black hair, navy half-sleeve shirt, thin wire-rimmed glasses

scenes.narration: Ishaan retypes his long email address on every single form.
scenes.caption: ईशान हर फ़ॉर्म में अपना लंबा ईमेल पता दोबारा टाइप करता है।
scenes.image_brief: A signup form on an iPhone screen with an empty email field and the keyboard open below it, the phone propped against a closed laptop on a wooden desk, cool afternoon light.

scenes.narration: The keyboard only suggests words it has already learned from you.
scenes.caption: कीबोर्ड वही शब्द सुझाता है जो उसने आपसे सीखे हों।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone keyboard with a completely empty grey suggestion strip above it and a blank note filling the rest of the screen, the phone flat on a dark desk, soft lamp light.

scenes.narration: An email address is not a word, so nothing ever appears.
scenes.caption: ईमेल पता कोई शब्द नहीं है, इसलिए सुझाव कभी नहीं आता।
scenes.image_brief: A long email address typed out letter by letter on an iPhone screen with one letter clearly mistyped and underlined in red, the phone held above a cafe table, warm window light.

scenes.narration: First pick a trigger you would never type by accident.
scenes.caption: पहले ऐसा ट्रिगर चुनें जो ग़लती से कभी टाइप न हो।
scenes.image_brief: A paper notepad beside a black iPhone with three characters written large on the top sheet in pencil, a kitchen table surface, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: Two letters work well. Try eml, or a double at sign.
scenes.caption: दो अक्षर अच्छे रहते हैं। जैसे eml या दो बार @ चिह्न।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone note showing only the three letters e m l typed on the first line with the cursor blinking after them, the phone on a pale linen cloth, even daylight.

scenes.narration: Open Settings. Go to General, then Keyboard, then Text Replacement.
scenes.caption: सेटिंग्स खोलें। जनरल, फिर कीबोर्ड, फिर टेक्स्ट रिप्लेसमेंट में जाएँ।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone settings screen open at General with a Keyboard row visible in the list, the phone resting on a stack of printed paperwork, warm indoor light.

scenes.narration: Tap the plus sign. In Phrase, type out the full email address.
scenes.caption: प्लस पर टैप करें। फ़्रेज़ में पूरा ईमेल पता लिखें।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone Text Replacement screen with an empty list and a plus sign in the top right corner, the phone held in one hand over a desk, neutral light.

scenes.narration: In Shortcut, type your trigger. Tap Save, then leave Settings.
scenes.caption: शॉर्टकट में अपना ट्रिगर लिखें। सेव करें और सेटिंग्स से निकलें।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone Text Replacement editor filled in, a long email address in the phrase field and three short characters in the shortcut field, the phone flat on a grey desk, daylight.

scenes.narration: Open Notes. Type the trigger and press the space bar once.
scenes.caption: नोट्स खोलें। ट्रिगर टाइप करके एक बार स्पेस दबाएँ।
scenes.image_brief: A blank iPhone note with three characters typed on it and the wide space bar of the keyboard visible below, the phone on a wooden table, soft morning light.

scenes.narration: The whole address should drop in. Did it expand? You are set.
scenes.caption: पूरा पता अपने आप आ जाना चाहिए। आ गया? बस हो गया।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone note now showing a full email address on the line where three short characters had been, the phone held in one hand, bright indoor light.

scenes.narration: Never keep a password in here. Replacements sync and stay readable.
scenes.caption: यहाँ पासवर्ड कभी न रखें। ये सिंक होते हैं और पढ़े जा सकते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone Text Replacement list showing several saved entries in plain readable text, a padlock symbol crossed out on a sticky note beside the phone, a dark slate surface, dim light.

scenes.narration: Add your home address as a second entry, then fill a form.
scenes.caption: दूसरी एंट्री में घर का पता डालें, फिर कोई फ़ॉर्म भरें।
scenes.image_brief: A delivery address form open on an iPhone with a full home address already filled into its fields, the phone propped against a cardboard parcel, warm hallway light.

title: 😰 Trisha deleted the wrong photo... the Recently Deleted album she skips #iphone #photos
title_alts: 🙂 Trisha's Recently Deleted album holds a photo... recover it in seconds #iphone #photos
😳 Trisha waited a month for that photo... the thirty day limit #iphone #photorecovery
description_hook: Trisha thought a deleted photo was gone for good. It was sitting in an album she had never scrolled far enough to see, with a clock running on it.
setting: a study table and a kitchen at home

characters.name: Trisha
characters.description: forty-one, straight black hair to the shoulders, faded green sweatshirt, reading glasses pushed up on her head

claims.claim: keeps it for about thirty days
claims.basis: the Recently Deleted album's documented retention window, unchanged across many iOS releases; narration says about

scenes.narration: Trisha deleted the wrong photo, and her whole album looked empty.
scenes.caption: त्रिशा ने ग़लत फ़ोटो हटा दी और पूरा एल्बम ख़ाली लगने लगा।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone photo grid with one obvious gap where an image is missing, the surrounding thumbnails all showing a birthday party, the phone held over a cluttered study table, warm evening light.

scenes.narration: Deleting does not erase anything. It just moves the photo aside.
scenes.caption: डिलीट करने से कुछ मिटता नहीं। फ़ोटो सिर्फ़ किनारे चली जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: A single photo thumbnail shown halfway out of a grid and sliding into a small folder icon at the edge of the screen, the phone flat on a pale desk, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: A holding album keeps it for about thirty days, then clears it.
scenes.caption: एक अलग एल्बम उसे क़रीब तीस दिन रखता है, फिर हटा देता है।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone album screen where every thumbnail carries a small label counting down remaining days, a plain white desk surface underneath, cool even light.

scenes.narration: You need only the phone itself and your passcode or Face ID.
scenes.caption: बस फ़ोन और आपका पासकोड या फ़ेस आईडी चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: A black iPhone lying face up showing the Face ID unlock circle on screen, nothing else on a dark wooden table, low warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: Open Photos, then tap Albums along the bottom of the screen.
scenes.caption: फ़ोटोज़ खोलें, फिर नीचे एल्बम्स पर टैप करें।
scenes.image_brief: The Photos app open on an iPhone with the Albums tab on the bottom bar highlighted in blue, the phone propped against a plant pot, bright window light.

scenes.narration: Scroll right past every album, down to Utilities. Tap Recently Deleted.
scenes.caption: सारे एल्बम के नीचे यूटिलिटीज़ तक जाएँ। रीसेंटली डिलीटेड खोलें।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone albums list scrolled to the bottom showing a Utilities heading with a Recently Deleted row beneath it, the phone on the arm of a grey sofa, soft indoor light.

scenes.narration: Unlock it with your face. Select the photo, then tap Recover.
scenes.caption: चेहरे से अनलॉक करें। फ़ोटो चुनें, फिर रिकवर दबाएँ।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone Recently Deleted album with one photo marked by a blue tick and a Recover button at the bottom of the screen, the phone held in one hand, neutral daylight.

scenes.narration: Go back to Recents. The photo sits back under its original date.
scenes.caption: रीसेंट्स में लौटें। फ़ोटो अपनी पुरानी तारीख़ पर वापस मिलेगी।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone Recents grid with a restored photo of a birthday cake back in place among its neighbouring thumbnails, the phone on a kitchen table, warm daylight.

scenes.narration: Has the days remaining label gone? Then it is fully restored.
scenes.caption: दिन गिनने वाला लेबल हट गया? तो फ़ोटो पूरी तरह वापस है।
scenes.image_brief: A single photo open full screen on an iPhone with no countdown label anywhere on it, the phone resting on a stack of magazines, soft afternoon light.

scenes.narration: Past thirty days, nothing in here helps. Stop and check your backups.
scenes.caption: तीस दिन बाद यहाँ कुछ नहीं बचता। तब बैकअप देखें।
scenes.image_brief: An empty Recently Deleted album screen on an iPhone reading no photos, an external drive and a closed laptop beside the phone on a desk, dim light.

scenes.narration: Open Recently Deleted tonight and recover anything you still actually want back.
scenes.caption: आज ही रीसेंटली डिलीटेड खोलें और ज़रूरी फ़ोटो वापस लाएँ।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone showing the Recently Deleted album filled with several thumbnails and countdown labels, a mug of tea beside it on a wooden table, evening lamp light.

title: 🤨 Manav retypes numbers from photos... the Live Text icon he ignores #iphone #livetext
title_alts: 🙂 Manav's Live Text copies a number out of a photo... one tap #iphone #livetext
😬 Manav pasted a wrong digit from a photo... always read it back #iphone #livetext
description_hook: Manav photographs notice boards, then types the numbers out by thumb. Live Text already read them, and there is one kind of text it still gets wrong.
setting: a street notice board and a cafe table

characters.name: Manav
characters.description: twenty-four, cropped hair, olive canvas jacket over a white tee, a canvas sling bag across his chest

scenes.narration: Manav photographs a notice board, then types the number by hand.
scenes.caption: मानव नोटिस बोर्ड की फ़ोटो लेकर नंबर हाथ से टाइप करता है।
scenes.image_brief: A community notice board covered in paper flyers with one phone number printed large, an iPhone held up in front of it showing the same board, bright overcast daylight.

scenes.narration: A photo is only coloured pixels until something reads the shapes.
scenes.caption: फ़ोटो सिर्फ़ रंगीन पिक्सल है, जब तक कोई आकार नहीं पढ़े।
scenes.image_brief: A heavily enlarged photo of printed text on an iPhone screen so that the individual coloured squares are visible, the phone flat on a dark desk, cool light.

scenes.narration: Live Text does that reading for you, inside the Photos app.
scenes.caption: लाइव टेक्स्ट यह पढ़ाई फ़ोटोज़ एप में ही कर देता है।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone screen showing a photo of a paper flyer with each printed line outlined in a thin yellow box, the phone on a pale wooden counter, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Take one clear, straight photo. Let the text fill the frame.
scenes.caption: एक साफ़, सीधी फ़ोटो लें। टेक्स्ट पूरी फ़्रेम में आने दें।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone camera view of a printed notice held straight and filling the whole screen, taken at a bus stop, flat overcast daylight.

scenes.narration: Blurry or tilted shots give the reader almost nothing to work with.
scenes.caption: धुंधली या टेढ़ी फ़ोटो से पढ़ने को कुछ नहीं मिलता।
scenes.image_brief: Two photos side by side on an iPhone screen, the left one blurred and tilted, the right one sharp and square on, the phone on a grey desk mat, even light.

scenes.narration: Open the photo. A small bracketed icon appears in the bottom corner.
scenes.caption: फ़ोटो खोलें। नीचे कोने में एक छोटा ब्रैकेट आइकन दिखेगा।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone photo open full screen with a small bracketed square icon glowing in the bottom right corner, the phone held in one hand, warm room light.

scenes.narration: Tap that icon. The text lifts up and the background dims.
scenes.caption: उस आइकन पर टैप करें। टेक्स्ट उभरता है और बैकग्राउंड मंद पड़ जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone photo in which the printed text is highlighted and raised while the rest of the image sits darkened behind it, the phone on a cafe table, low warm light.

scenes.narration: Press and hold on the number, then choose Copy from the menu.
scenes.caption: नंबर को दबाकर रखें, फिर मेन्यू से कॉपी चुनें।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone screen showing a phone number selected inside a photo with a small pop-up menu of options floating above it, the phone in one hand, neutral light.

scenes.narration: Open your dialler and paste. Do the digits match the board?
scenes.caption: डायलर खोलकर पेस्ट करें। अंक बोर्ड से मिल रहे हैं?
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone dialler screen with a pasted phone number sitting in the field above the keypad, the original paper flyer lying beside the phone, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: Tapping a detected number also offers Call, straight from the photo.
scenes.caption: पहचाने गए नंबर पर टैप करते ही कॉल का विकल्प भी मिलता है।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone photo of a flyer with the phone number underlined and a call option shown just beneath it, the phone propped against a window ledge, soft morning light.

scenes.narration: Handwriting and decorative fonts still fail. Check every digit yourself.
scenes.caption: हस्तलिखित और सजावटी फ़ॉन्ट अब भी चूकते हैं। हर अंक ख़ुद जाँचें।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone photo of a handwritten note in looping cursive with nothing highlighted anywhere on it, the phone on a dark table, dim lamp light.

scenes.narration: Never paste a bank detail from a photo without reading it twice.
scenes.caption: फ़ोटो से बैंक की जानकारी पेस्ट करने से पहले दो बार पढ़ें।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone photo of a printed bank account slip lying on a desk, a red pen and a paper notepad beside the phone, hard overhead light.

scenes.narration: Photograph a menu tonight, then copy one line out of it.
scenes.caption: आज किसी मेन्यू की फ़ोटो लें और उसमें से एक लाइन कॉपी करें।
scenes.image_brief: A printed restaurant menu lying open on a table with an iPhone held above it showing the same menu in camera view, warm evening restaurant light.

title: 😳 Ruhi's data vanishes overnight... the Background App Refresh switch #iphone #mobiledata
title_alts: 🙂 Ruhi sets Background App Refresh to Wi-Fi... her data stops draining #iphone #mobiledata
😬 Ruhi switched off every refresh... the maps app she needed working #iphone #mobiledata
description_hook: Ruhi's phone spent her data while it sat in a bag doing nothing. Here is how to find the apps responsible, and the three you should leave alone.
setting: a hallway bench and a kitchen counter
protagonist_type: student on a small data plan

characters.name: Ruhi
characters.description: nineteen, long hair in a loose braid, oversized maroon hoodie, a cracked screen protector on her phone

claims.claim: Note the top three data users there
claims.basis: round illustrative cut-off chosen to keep the fix short, not a measured threshold

scenes.narration: Ruhi's data runs out while her phone sits in her bag.
scenes.caption: बैग में पड़े फ़ोन का डेटा रुही का ख़त्म हो जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone lying inside an open shoulder bag on a hallway bench, its screen showing a low data warning banner, dim evening light.

scenes.narration: Apps keep working after you close them, refreshing quietly in the background.
scenes.caption: एप बंद करने के बाद भी चुपचाप चलते और रिफ़्रेश होते रहते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone home screen where several app icons each carry a small spinning circular arrow, the phone flat on a bedside table, a dark room lit by a night light.

scenes.narration: On mobile data, all that quiet refreshing is what empties your plan.
scenes.caption: मोबाइल डेटा पर यही चुपचाप रिफ़्रेश होना प्लान ख़ाली कर देता है।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone Cellular settings screen showing a wide data usage bar almost completely filled, the phone on a white desk, cool daylight.

scenes.narration: Open Settings, then Cellular. Scroll down to the long list of apps.
scenes.caption: सेटिंग्स, फिर सेल्युलर खोलें। नीचे एप की लंबी लिस्ट तक जाएँ।
scenes.image_brief: The iPhone Cellular settings screen scrolled to a long list of apps with a data figure beside each name, the phone held in one hand, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: Note the top three data users there. Those are your real problem.
scenes.caption: सबसे ज़्यादा डेटा खाने वाले तीन एप देखें। असली समस्या वही हैं।
scenes.image_brief: The same Cellular app list on an iPhone with the three largest data figures at the top of it circled, a pencil resting on the desk beside the phone, even light.

scenes.narration: Now open Settings again, then General, then Background App Refresh.
scenes.caption: अब सेटिंग्स, जनरल, फिर बैकग्राउंड एप रिफ़्रेश पर जाएँ।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone General settings screen with a Background App Refresh row visible in the middle of the list, the phone propped against a coffee cup, warm morning light.

scenes.narration: Tap the heading itself and choose Wi-Fi, not Wi-Fi and Cellular.
scenes.caption: ऊपर हेडिंग पर टैप करें और वाई-फ़ाई चुनें, सेल्युलर नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone Background App Refresh screen showing three choices with a tick beside the Wi-Fi option, the phone on a dark desk mat, neutral light.

scenes.narration: Below it, switch refresh off for those three heaviest apps individually.
scenes.caption: नीचे उन तीन भारी एप के लिए रिफ़्रेश बंद कर दें।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone Background App Refresh list where three toggles sit switched off in a column of switched-on toggles, the phone held in one hand, soft indoor light.

scenes.narration: Return to Cellular, scroll to the bottom, and tap Reset Statistics.
scenes.caption: सेल्युलर में लौटें, सबसे नीचे जाकर रीसेट स्टैटिस्टिक्स दबाएँ।
scenes.image_brief: The bottom of an iPhone Cellular settings screen showing a Reset Statistics option with a period line above it, the phone on a wooden table, warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: Check the same list tomorrow. Are those numbers much smaller now?
scenes.caption: कल यही लिस्ट देखें। संख्या काफ़ी कम हुई है?
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone Cellular app list showing very small data figures beside every app name, a plain wall calendar hanging behind the phone, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: Leave refresh switched on for maps, messaging, and anything medical.
scenes.caption: नक़्शे, मैसेजिंग और मेडिकल एप के लिए रिफ़्रेश चालू रखें।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone mounted on a car dashboard showing a live navigation map with a highlighted route, morning sunlight coming through the windscreen.

scenes.narration: Reset your statistics tonight, then look at the list after one day.
scenes.caption: आज ही स्टैटिस्टिक्स रीसेट करें, एक दिन बाद लिस्ट देखें।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone showing a freshly reset Cellular settings screen where every data figure reads zero, a cup of tea beside it on a kitchen counter, evening light.

title: 😬 Chirag slept through four calls... the Allow Repeated Calls switch #iphone #donotdisturb
title_alts: 🙂 Chirag's Do Not Disturb lets family through... one switch does it #iphone #donotdisturb
😳 Chirag let repeated calls ring... the spam dialers that repeat too #iphone #donotdisturb
description_hook: Chirag's phone stayed silent through call after call from home. Do Not Disturb can let the right people ring without opening the door to everyone.
setting: a bedroom at night and a kitchen counter
protagonist_type: shift worker sleeping in the day

characters.name: Chirag
characters.description: thirty-six, thinning hair cut short, grey crew-neck sweatshirt, a thin leather band on his right wrist

claims.basis: round illustrative figure describing one person's night, not a measured statistic

scenes.narration: Chirag slept through four calls from his own father last night.
scenes.caption: चिराग अपने पिता की चार कॉल सोते हुए मिस कर गया।
scenes.image_brief: A dark bedroom at night with an iPhone face up on the bedside table showing four missed calls on its lock screen, the screen glow the only light.

scenes.narration: Do Not Disturb silences every ring. It never asks who is calling.
scenes.caption: डू नॉट डिस्टर्ब हर घंटी चुप कर देता है। किसकी कॉल है, नहीं पूछता।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone lock screen with a small crescent moon icon at the top and an incoming call banner sitting quietly below it, a dark room, screen glow only.

scenes.narration: Emergency, or a delivery alert? Both get the same silent treatment.
scenes.caption: इमरजेंसी या डिलीवरी अलर्ट? दोनों को एक जैसी चुप्पी मिलती है।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone lock screen stacked with two identical looking silent notifications, one a hospital call and one a parcel delivery alert, a dark room, screen glow.

scenes.narration: Decide right now which two or three people must always reach you.
scenes.caption: अभी तय करें कि दो-तीन लोग आपको हमेशा मिल सकें।
scenes.image_brief: A paper list on a kitchen counter with three names written on it in pen beside a black iPhone, morning daylight through a window.

scenes.narration: Open your Contacts app and check those cards actually exist there.
scenes.caption: कॉन्टैक्ट्स एप खोलकर देखें कि उनके कार्ड मौजूद हैं।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone Contacts app open showing a short list of three contact cards, the phone held in one hand above a table, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Go to Settings, then Focus, and tap Do Not Disturb.
scenes.caption: सेटिंग्स, फिर फ़ोकस, फिर डू नॉट डिस्टर्ब पर जाएँ।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone Focus settings screen with a Do Not Disturb row at the top of the list, the phone resting on a folded blanket, warm bedside lamp light.

scenes.narration: Under People, tap Allow Notifications From, and add each of those contacts.
scenes.caption: पीपल में अलाउ नोटिफ़िकेशन्स फ़्रॉम पर टैप करके वे कॉन्टैक्ट जोड़ें।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone Do Not Disturb screen with a People section showing three small contact photos added beneath it, the phone flat on a bedside table, low warm light.

scenes.narration: Scroll further down the page and switch on Allow Repeated Calls.
scenes.caption: और नीचे जाकर अलाउ रिपीटेड कॉल्स चालू कर दें।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone Do Not Disturb screen scrolled down to an Allow Repeated Calls toggle switched on and glowing green, the phone in one hand, dim room light.

scenes.narration: Ask someone to call you twice, quickly. The second should ring through.
scenes.caption: किसी से जल्दी-जल्दी दो बार कॉल कराएँ। दूसरी घंटी बजनी चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone on a bedside table ringing with a second incoming call from the same contact, its screen bright inside a dark bedroom.

scenes.narration: Persistent spam dialers repeat calls too. Keep screening numbers you do not know.
scenes.caption: स्पैम कॉलर भी दोबारा मिलाते हैं। अनजान नंबर जाँचते रहें।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone lock screen showing two calls in a row from the same unknown number, the phone on a cluttered desk, harsh overhead light.

scenes.narration: Add one emergency contact tonight, then have them test both calls.
scenes.caption: आज एक इमरजेंसी कॉन्टैक्ट जोड़ें, फिर उनसे टेस्ट कराएँ।
scenes.image_brief: An iPhone contact card open with an emergency contact label showing on it, the phone held in one hand in a lit living room, evening lamp light.
